name: qa.core
author: VORTEX-OS
description: Shared basic QA checks. Called by every qa.* specialist (never directly by reviewer.quality). Performs: file exists, nonzero size, image dimensions within expected range (catches 1x1 placeholders, 0x0 corruption, aspect-ratio mistakes), audio duration matches expected (+/-10%), video has an audio track if one was requested, and placeholder-text-file detection (the last-ditch 'local-placeholder-text' provider writes a plain text file that the engine can see as 'invalid mp4' -- this check flags it). Returns a verdict with score 0-1, finding list, and retry hint.

files.description: JSON object mapping each artifact kind to its file path. E.g. { 'hero_slide_01': 'C:/.../slide-01.png', 'voiceover_slide_01': 'C:/.../slide-01.wav', ... }

expected_dimensions.description: JSON object mapping artifact kind to { min_width, min_height } for image checks, or { min_duration_s, max_duration_s } for audio/video. Default: skip dimension checks for any kind not listed.

findings.description: JSON array of finding objects: { kind, severity ('info'|'low'|'medium'|'high'|'critical'), message, file, retry_hint? }

provider.description: local (always; no mcode-tools call needed for basic checks)
